SCOPE.title: Scope containment
SCOPE.predicate: Every path in the diff matches a glob in capability.scope.
blind_spots: Symlinks and case folding can map a path differently on another filesystem.

SUITE.title: Full test suite
SUITE.predicate: Zero failing test ids on sqlite and on postgres.
blind_spots: A flaky test can pass by chance; only THREAD_RACE repeats executions.

TEST_SET.title: Test set integrity
TEST_SET.predicate: Every base test id exists at head and passes, removals carry a reason_code and covered_by, no skip or xfail is added, no assertion count is lowered, and no added assertion matches a tautology pattern.
blind_spots: Coverage-subset comparison depends on sealed coverage data being complete.

TEST_INFRA.title: Test-infrastructure containment
TEST_INFRA.predicate: No diff touches a path in gate.test_infra_paths unless that path is in capability.scope.
blind_spots: Test discovery configured outside the listed paths is not visible.

BASE_FAIL_HEAD_PASS.title: Added-test falsifiability
BASE_FAIL_HEAD_PASS.predicate: Every added test fails on base with fail_kind ASSERTION and passes on head; a base-green test is NON_FALSIFIABLE unless named in characterization_tests; acceptance is re-derived when the acceptance author family equals the builder family.
blind_spots: A test that fails on base for an unrelated assertion still satisfies the ASSERTION fail_kind.

MUTATION.title: Mutation adequacy
MUTATION.predicate: Kill ratio is at or above the tier threshold and every changed hunk in a high-tier path has at least one killed mutant.
blind_spots: Equivalent mutants survive legitimately and are scored as survivors.

CHANGELOG.title: Changelog coverage
CHANGELOG.predicate: Every added row names a subset of diff paths and every non-exempt diff path appears in at least one added row.
blind_spots: A syntactically valid invariant sentence can still name the wrong property.

SECRETS.title: Secret scan
SECRETS.predicate: secret-scan reports zero hits on added lines beyond secrets-baseline.json.
blind_spots: Secrets in binary files, build artifacts, and runtime configuration are not scanned.

CONVENTION.title: Lint convention
CONVENTION.predicate: The ruff rule set reports zero violations on added lines.
blind_spots: Rules outside the selected ruff set are not enforced.

SMELL.title: Test and code smell delta
SMELL.predicate: No new smell appears on an added line; pre-existing smells that the diff did not increase are residual.
blind_spots: Delta metrics miss code moved from another file.

GATE_CONTROLS.title: Gate negative controls
GATE_CONTROLS.predicate: Every known-bad fixture is rejected, controls_total meets each per-check minimum and known_bad_min (total_min is the declared-entry floor), and controls_rejected equals controls_total for the current gate_sha, control_set_sha, and policy_digest.
blind_spots: Controls prove rejection of known-bad fixtures, not completeness of the gate.

POLICY_DIGEST.title: Policy digest binding
POLICY_DIGEST.predicate: Hash policies/** as sorted path and sha256 pairs; a changed digest requires a gate-control record carrying that digest, and a record with a different digest fails as POLICY_DRIFT.
blind_spots: The digest proves policy bytes changed, not that the change is correct.

ARCH.title: Architecture containment
ARCH.predicate: A new cross-layer edge, dependency, public export, or unowned module path is refused unless capability.architecture_allow declares it with a reason.
blind_spots: Dynamic imports and runtime plugin loading are invisible statically.

ORACLE_PROVENANCE.title: Oracle provenance
ORACLE_PROVENANCE.predicate: No added assertion line is a SELF_COMPARE, ORACLE_BY_COPY, or MOCK_ECHO according to assert-rules.json.
blind_spots: An oracle computed by a different but wrong path is not detectable statically.

GUARD_DELTA.title: Guard removal coverage
GUARD_DELTA.predicate: Every removed conditional or guard line in a high-tier path is named by an added test covering the changed hunk or by capability.guard_delta.
blind_spots: A guard moved between files is a removal plus an addition; the destination hunk must still be covered.

AUTHZ_MATRIX.title: Authorization matrix
AUTHZ_MATRIX.predicate: Every URLconf route and method has a matrix row and each role client is compared with the view's declared permission classes.
blind_spots: Object-level permissions are not visible in the route matrix; the hacker covers them.
AUTHZ_MATRIX.required_reason: fails if backend route added without permission rules

SEMGREP.title: Semantic grep ruleset
SEMGREP.predicate: The project ruleset in policies/semgrep.yml reports zero new findings on added lines, each with its policy class tag.
blind_spots: AST and regex rules miss semantic equivalents and generated code.

THREAD_RACE.title: Thread and process race
THREAD_RACE.predicate: When the closure touches a lock, atomic block, idempotency key, or watermark, added concurrency tests run on postgres for the tier's thread_race_repetitions_by_runner[runner] repetitions per worker with thread_race_workers workers, and reproduce the protected property every time.
blind_spots: SQLite green is insufficient; only postgres repetitions count.

SCHEMA_FUZZ.title: OpenAPI schema fuzz
SCHEMA_FUZZ.predicate: schemathesis runs with the fixed seed on added routes and changed shapes and observes no schema violation or 5xx response.
blind_spots: Schema-derived cases do not cover authorization or business invariants.

BOOTTEST.title: Production boot test
BOOTTEST.predicate: The app boots with production settings and DEBUG=false, answers a health probe, and exits non-zero when a required environment variable is removed.
blind_spots: A boot that reads a different config source can mask a missing variable.

ZIZMOR.title: GitHub Actions hardening
ZIZMOR.predicate: When .github/** is in the closure, or weekly on base otherwise, zizmor reports no finding above the policy threshold.
blind_spots: Only GitHub Actions workflow semantics are modeled.

DAST_BASELINE.title: Dynamic application security baseline
DAST_BASELINE.predicate: At max only, the ZAP baseline scan against the hacker runtime has no alert above the policy threshold; informational alerts are residual.
blind_spots: A passive baseline cannot prove absence of exploitable issues.

AGT_PARITY.title: AGT policy and install parity
AGT_PARITY.predicate: The resolved AGT policy path is <root>/.agt/policy.json, opencode.json names exactly @microsoft/agent-governance-opencode@5.0.0 as its only plugin, .opencode/package.json pins 5.0.0, the lockfile resolves 5.0.0, and the policy body equals the mandated advisory contract.
blind_spots: A byte-identical policy can still be semantically wrong; parity proves shape and pins, not policy quality.
Parity does not prove the plugin loads under the installed OpenCode plugin API.

AGT_AUDIT.title: AGT deny audit evidence
AGT_AUDIT.predicate: Every deny entry in the AGT audit log carries action and decision fields, and a golden expectation of a deny is satisfied by at least one deny entry.
blind_spots: The log is accepted as a JSON array or JSONL; the hash chain is not recomputed.
Absence of a deny is only detectable when a golden expectation records that a deny occurred.
